items.name: Oxford Street
items.location: Oxford Circus to Marble Arch
items.description: London's busiest shopping street for department stores, global brands, trainers, beauty, and quick central browsing.
items.highlights: Nike, H&M, Zara, Primark, Selfridges, John Lewis, Marks & Spencer, ASOS, Topshop building

subShops.name: Selfridges
subShops.note: London's most iconic department store — 5 floors of luxury fashion, beauty, tech and food.

subShops.name: Primark
subShops.note: Europe's biggest Primark — massive 5-floor store with fashion, beauty and homeware at unbeatable prices.

subShops.name: H&M
subShops.note: Affordable everyday fashion for women, men and kids across multiple floors.

subShops.name: Zara
subShops.note: On-trend fashion and accessories across 3 floors of the flagship Oxford Street store.

subShops.name: Nike Town
subShops.note: Massive flagship store with the latest Nike trainers, sportswear and exclusive drops.

subShops.name: John Lewis
subShops.note: Classic British department store — tech, home, fashion and beauty all in one place.

items.name: Carnaby Street
items.location: Soho
items.description: Colourful pedestrian streets with independent labels, sneaker shops, restaurants, and easy access to Liberty.

subShops.name: Levi's
subShops.note: The original denim brand — jeans, jackets and streetwear. Classic and modern fits.

subShops.name: Vans
subShops.note: Iconic skate brand with shoes, clothing and accessories. Exclusives you won't find elsewhere.

subShops.name: Dr. Martens
subShops.note: The original Carnaby boots — classic 1460s, Chelsea boots and seasonal collaborations.

subShops.name: Liberty London
subShops.note: Just steps away — iconic Tudor building with luxury fashion, beauty and the famous Liberty print fabrics.

items.name: King's Road
items.location: Chelsea
items.description: Chelsea shopping with fashion boutiques, interior design stores, cafes, and a polished west London pace.

subShops.name: Anthropologie
subShops.note: Beautiful bohemian fashion, homeware and gifts. One of the most gorgeous shops on King's Road.

subShops.name: Peter Jones
subShops.note: A Chelsea institution and John Lewis partner — fashion, home, beauty and tech.

subShops.name: Vivienne Westwood
subShops.note: The original punk-turned-luxury British designer. Bold, iconic and uniquely British.

subShops.name: Space NK
subShops.note: Premium beauty and skincare — Nars, Charlotte Tilbury, By Terry and more cult brands.

items.name: Westfield Stratford City
items.location: Stratford
items.description: Large indoor mall with fashion, tech, food courts, cinema, and direct links to the Elizabeth line and Central line.

subShops.name: John Lewis
subShops.note: Flagship Westfield store — tech, fashion, home and beauty all under one roof.

subShops.name: Zara
subShops.note: On-trend fashion for women, men and kids. Multiple floors in the Westfield location.

subShops.name: Apple Store
subShops.note: Full Apple product range — iPhone, Mac, iPad and accessories with Genius Bar support.

subShops.name: Nike
subShops.note: Latest Nike trainers and sportswear. Great for limited edition drops.

subShops.name: Adidas
subShops.note: Flagship Adidas store — trainers, sportswear, Originals and exclusive collab pieces.

items.name: Canary Wharf
items.location: Docklands
items.description: Sleek malls, restaurants, waterside walks, and public art beneath the financial district's towers.

subShops.name: Marks & Spencer
subShops.note: Great M&S food hall for lunch plus classic British clothing and homeware.

subShops.name: Reiss
subShops.note: Contemporary British fashion — sharp workwear, occasion wear and weekend casual.

subShops.name: Hugo Boss
subShops.note: German premium fashion — tailored suits, smart casual and sportswear.

subShops.name: Sweaty Betty
subShops.note: Premium British activewear for women — yoga, running and gym wear that actually looks good.

items.name: Covent Garden
items.location: West End
items.description: Beauty brands, boutiques, Apple Market crafts, street performers, and excellent pre-theatre browsing.

subShops.name: Apple Store
subShops.note: Stunning Apple flagship store inside the historic market building. Full range with Genius Bar.

subShops.name: Mulberry
subShops.note: British luxury leather bags and accessories. Somerset and Bayswater bags are iconic.

subShops.name: Lush
subShops.note: Handmade cosmetics, bath bombs, shampoo bars and fresh skincare in the flagship Covent Garden store.

subShops.name: Jo Malone
subShops.note: Classic British perfume house — colognes, candles and bath products in stunning packaging.

subShops.name: Fossil
subShops.note: Stylish watches, leather bags and accessories at accessible luxury prices.

items.name: Portobello Road Area
items.location: Notting Hill
items.description: Pastel streets, antique dealers, vintage clothing, cafes, and one of London's most photogenic market walks.

subShops.name: Antique Stalls
subShops.note: Hundreds of stalls selling silverware, vintage jewellery, ceramics and rare collectibles.

subShops.name: Vintage Clothing Stalls
subShops.note: Amazing selection of vintage and retro clothing — 1950s to 1990s fashion.

subShops.name: Books for Cooks
subShops.note: Legendary cookbook shop with a tiny test kitchen inside where recipes are cooked daily.

subShops.name: The Spice Shop
subShops.note: Incredible selection of global spices, teas, herbs and exotic ingredients from around the world.

items.name: Borough Market
items.location: London Bridge
items.description: Historic food market for artisan produce, prepared dishes, baked goods, spices, coffee, and edible gifts.

subShops.name: Neal's Yard Dairy
subShops.note: The best British and Irish artisan cheeses — friendly staff who let you taste before you buy.

subShops.name: Monmouth Coffee
subShops.note: London's best coffee. Queue is always worth it — iconic Borough Market institution since 1978.

subShops.name: The Flour Station
subShops.note: Incredible sourdough and artisan breads baked fresh daily — sellout by midday on weekends.

subShops.name: Turnips
subShops.note: Best fruit, vegetables and herbs from award-winning Borough Market traders.

items.name: Portobello Road Market
items.location: Notting Hill
items.openingHours: Monday-Saturday; Saturday is main antiques day
items.description: Antiques, vintage clothes, bric-a-brac, produce, and colourful Notting Hill streets in one long market route.

items.name: Columbia Road Flower Market
items.location: Bethnal Green
items.description: Plants, flowers, independent shops, and loud market banter. Go early for space or late for bargains.

items.name: Camden Market
items.location: Camden Town
items.description: A sprawling mix of food stalls, music culture, vintage, souvenirs, canalside views, and bold street style.

subShops.name: Stables Market
subShops.note: Huge market in Victorian horse stables — vintage clothing, tattoos, alternative fashion and street food.

subShops.name: Camden Lock Market
subShops.note: Artisan food traders, handmade crafts and unique gifts right by the canal.

subShops.name: Psychedelic Vintage
subShops.note: Incredible vintage clothing and retro pieces from every era — great for unique finds.

subShops.name: Electric Market
subShops.note: Band tees, vinyl records, punk fashion and music memorabilia across multiple stalls.

items.name: Greenwich Market
items.location: Greenwich
items.description: Covered market with crafts, jewellery, street food, and easy access to the Cutty Sark and park.

subShops.name: Antique Stalls

subShops.name: Artisan Food Stalls

subShops.name: Craft & Handmade Stalls
subShops.note: Local artists selling handmade jewellery, ceramics, prints and gifts.

items.name: Old Spitalfields Market

subShops.name: Street Food Traders

subShops.name: Tatty Devine
subShops.note: Fun, colourful acrylic jewellery handmade in London. Perfect for unique gifts.

subShops.name: Vintage & Art Stalls
subShops.note: Second-hand books, handmade art, ceramics and gifts from local artists every week.

items.name: Brick Lane Market

items.description: Vintage clothing, records, street food, curry houses, murals, and East London weekend energy.

subShops.note: Massive indoor warehouse full of vintage clothing by weight — one of the best in London.

subShops.name: Street Food Stalls
subShops.note: London's most diverse food market — Bengali curries, salt beef bagels, Ethiopian and more.

subShops.name: Vintage Record Stalls
subShops.note: Vinyl records, cassettes and music memorabilia for collectors and music lovers.

items.name: Bermondsey Antiques Market

items.name: Leather Lane Market

items.name: Fortnum & Mason

subShops.name: Food Hall
subShops.note: Exquisite hampers, biscuits, preserves, teas, chocolates and luxury groceries.

subShops.name: Chocolate & Confectionery

subShops.name: Gifts & Homeware
